evidence.title: Canvas UI: Creative Canvas, WebGL and WebGPU Component Library
Rendering: WebGL and WebGPU | Canvas UI

name: Canvas UI
summary: Open source component library of WebGL and WebGPU canvas effects that run over live HTML, installed via a shadcn registry.
description: Creative html-in-canvas effects for React, Solid, Preact, Vue, Svelte and vanilla TypeScript: ASCII lenses, fluid simulations, fire, glass, particles and 3D objects drawn over fully interactive HTML. Every effect ships as a WebGL and a WebGPU (vgpu) build with the same API, as single source files served through the shadcn-compatible @canvas-ui registry.
contains: 420 shadcn registry items covering both renderer builds across six frameworks
every effect ships in six flavors: React, Solid, Preact, Vue, Svelte and vanilla TypeScript
two renderer builds per effect: WebGL (GLSL, zero dependencies) and WebGPU (WGSL, via vgpu)
free forever under MIT + Commons Clause: personal and commercial use allowed, reselling the components is not
